data.title: Eden House Za’abeel
data.about:
Discover Eden House Za’abeel in DIFC, a visionary creation by H&H Development that redefines upscale city living, offering a resort-like lifestyle with signature and à la carte services. This new luxury apartment project in Dubai DIFC features 1, 2, & 3-bedroom super-prime residences, exquisitely designed by Tristan Auer, and lush green spaces masterfully landscaped by Vladimir Djurovic. With a flexible payment plan starting at just 10% booking, owning a home in this iconic development is now within reach.

Residents can indulge in world-class amenities, including wellness suites, private courtyards, and indoor/outdoor pools, all designed to enhance their living experience. Strategically located in the heart of Dubai, Eden House Za’abeel provides unparalleled access to the city’s premier business, dining, and cultural destinations, making it a coveted address for professionals and urban sophisticates. With its meticulously crafted interiors, verdant green landscapes, and an emphasis on modern luxury, Eden House Za’abeel sets a new benchmark for elevated urban living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Eden House Za'abeel: A Masterpiece of Modern Sophistication and Artisan Craftsmanship
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exceptional Design: A modern 235m linear tower crafted by DXB LAB, a Dubai-based architectural firm, with vertical gardens and multi-level courtyards.
  • Prime Location: Strategically positioned near Al Mustaqbal Street and DIFC Gate Building, offering unmatched connectivity to Dubai’s financial and cultural hub.
  • Luxurious Residences: 1-3 bedroom apartments featuring elegant interiors by Tristan Auer, full-height windows, and wrap-around terraces.
  • Signature Services: 24/7 concierge, valet parking, housekeeping, private chef options, and a la carte services.
  • Exclusive Living: Separate residential and retail zones, with a private entrance for residents from the Za’abeel side, ensuring privacy and exclusivity.
  • Signature Brand by H&H Development: A standout among H&H new developments, part of the Eden House portfolio renowned for creating luxury residences Eden House DIFC.
  • Heritage-Infused Landscaping: Landscaped by Vladimir Djurovic, the project honors Emirati heritage with local ghaf trees and natural ecosystems.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: 10% on booking and 50% on completion, offering convenience and accessibility to investors and homebuyers alike.

location_tile.title: DIFC: A Global Hub of Finance Art, and Innovation
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Eden House Za’abeel is perfectly positioned in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). With its seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and proximity to Dubai International Airport, Eden House Za’abeel provides residents with the ultimate convenience of urban city living along with uderstated sophistication.

Surrounded by world-class restaurants, art galleries, and business hubs, it’s the perfect base for professionals, entrepreneurs, and urban sophisticates. The development’s proximity to Al Mustaqbal Street and DIFC Gate Building enhances connectivity while maintaining exclusivity through private residential entry points, creating a harmonious balance between city living and serene retreat.

  • 6 minutes to Museum of the Future
  • 10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 10 minutes to Dubai Mall
  • 15 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 25 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
